patch_description: Directly optimize the true objective (dmin/dmax)^2 for 14 free points in 3D. Strategy: generate many starting configurations via spherical repulsion (points spread on a unit sphere give a good initialization), then refine each with scipy L-BFGS on a smooth surrogate (soft-min over soft-max of pairwise distances), and finally polish with a direct local search of the exact ratio. Keep the best-scoring configuration over all restarts. Fixed seeds, deterministic, fast (42 optimization variables, 91 distances per evaluation).
